def verify_costas_array(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    vectors = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
            dc = j - i
            if (dr, dc) in vectors:
                print(f"Duplicate vector ({dr}, {dc}) between columns {i} and {j}")
                return False
            vectors.add((dr, dc))
    print(f"All {len(vectors)} vectors are distinct")
    print(f"Vectors: {sorted(vectors)}")
    return True

perm = [0, 1, 4, 6, 5, 3, 7, 2]

print(f"Is valid permutation: {sorted(perm) == list(range(8))}")
print(f"Is Costas array: {verify_costas_array(perm)}")
